digest.component_or_area: contribution process documentation and code review guidance
propositions: Change holds recorded in ticket comments or session logs are invisible to submitters and not enforceable in the contribution flow.
Gerrit's Work In Progress state provides an enforceable mechanism that prevents submission and is already understood by all submitter types (humans, bots, agents).
Documentation must teach authors to mark changes with known unresolved issues as WIP immediately using either push-time syntax or REST toggle, with rationale and both forms provided.

The rule must be surfaced across three documentation surfaces (CONTRIBUTING.md, passing-code-review.md guide, and AGENTS.md) so it is reachable through the packaged on-ramp without opening multiple docs.
Tests must verify the rule is present and reachable through the packaged guide registry mapping, not just present in files.
